pages.name: 01_BRAND_CONCEPT
evidence: Brand name, proposition, vector hero and operating process form a clear four-level reading path.
The dual-compartment dish and cross-seam ingredients visibly encode the shared-base/final-split rule.
The lower process module resolves excessive empty space without turning the page into an explanation board.
limiters: Figma-native food illustration is structurally clear but less appetising than high-quality real photography.
The page uses more explanatory copy than the other two proof pages.

pages.name: 02_WORDMARK_SYMBOL
evidence: Large Chinese wordmark, concise concept statement and construction matrix create an immediate hierarchy.
The super-symbol repeats the exact same final-branch logic used on the concept and packaging pages.
Dark-ground inversion adds portfolio rhythm while preserving the same type and color system.
limiters: The wordmark remains a Figma concept direction built from a real font plus geometry, not a finished custom vector logo.
The lower construction matrix is visually technical and may need simplification for a public-facing post.

pages.name: 03_HERO_APPLICATION
evidence: The packaging hero occupies the dominant visual area and reads immediately as two boxes linked by one sleeve.
Adult/child labels, connector and detachable rail diagram translate the brand promise into a physical structure.
The page communicates a real application rather than a generic logo-on-mockup exercise.
limiters: The packaging is a vector concept and has not been validated against a supplier dieline.
Food transport details such as vents and leak resistance require later production development.

strongest_evidence: The operating rule remains visible across concept, wordmark and packaging pages.
All visible Chinese text is real editable Figma text.
Three distinct layout archetypes share one disciplined token system.
largest_limiters: No stable personal aesthetic anchors exist, so private fit cannot be scored.
No real food photography is available; the product layer is represented by editable vectors.
The wordmark and packaging require later vector and production refinement.
exact_edit_order: Replace or supplement vector food imagery with real or clean no-text food photography after the generator context is reset.
Refine the final strokes of the Chinese wordmark into a dedicated vector construction.
Validate dual-box dimensions, vents, seal and leak resistance with a packaging supplier.
